name: Moodle
tagline: Your school or university coursework in your pocket
description:
Moodle is the official app for Moodle sites — the learning platform thousands of schools, universities and workplaces use for their courses. Sign in to your institution's site and you get your courses, files, quizzes, grades and course calendar on your phone.

You can download course material to read on the bus with no signal, get a push notification when a teacher posts something or a deadline is near, message classmates and tutors, upload work from your phone, and keep an eye on your badges and progress.

It only works if your school, college or employer already runs a Moodle site — there is nothing to browse on your own. You will need the site address and the same login you use in a web browser.
